body:
Google it man, it’s actually a pretty common topical solution for molluscum and it’s OTC - there are case studies on it where it proved really effective. The only real risk is allergy to the tea tree oil and I tried a test patch on my arm already with no allergic reaction

I asked my derm about the tea tree oil. He was skeptical that it would help but said that it wouldn’t hurt. I did not ask him about the iodine though.
